newsitem.title: UK: Copper consumption growth seen strong - CRU.
newsitem.headline: Copper consumption growth seen strong - CRU.

text.p: World copper consumption is growing strongly, and the prospects are for growth to continue at double the historic average of 1.5 percent a year, industry specialists CRU International said.
In a special report CRU said construction is now the big growth market for copper, more than compenstating for reduced usage in telecommunications.
"By 2010 global annual consumption levels should reach almost 18 million tonnes, 50 percent more than today," it said.

Copper usage in emerging countries, such as China, India, will account for almost half of the increase. The market will also gain from the recovery of the CIS and Eastern European countries, which will use an extra 1.6 million tonnes by 2010, it added.
